excerpts: Cousins went 21 of 31 for 207 yards just five days after rejoining the Vikings, who acquired him from the [Las Vegas Raiders](http://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/lv/las-vegas-raiders) at Tuesday’s trade deadline. ... Cousins rejuvenated an offense that had stalled under quarterbacks [Kyler Murray](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3917315/kyler-murray) and [Carson Wentz](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/2573079/carson-wentz) , scoring 16 points or fewer in each of its last three games. He helped the Vikings snap a two-game skid as they beat the Packers for the fifth time in six meetings. And he reestablished his connection with top receiver [Justin Jefferson](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4262921/justin-jefferson) , who had season highs in catches (nine) and targets (13) while finishing with 74 yards. ... Cousins threw a 38-yarder to Price in the first period and a 20-yarder to Bartholomew in the fourth. Each of Minnesota's three touchdown drives included a third-and-long completion from Cousins.

recap.paragraph: Could Kirk Cousins spark the Vikings in his return? He sure did! Cousins tossed 2 touchdown passes as Minnesota beat Green Bay 30-10 in Wisconsin. Myles Price snagged the first, and Aaron Jones ran for another score. Jordan Love threw a touchdown pass to J. Michael Sturdivant for the Packers. Then Cousins found Gavin Bartholomew for his second touchdown! The Vikings snapped a 2-game skid and moved to 7-2.
